what: Plan lists macOS and Linux stat flags but does not specify runtime selection or numeric validation
scenario_or_breakage: Implementer may call only stat -f %m on Linux; GNU stat treats -f as --file-system and emits multi-line non-numeric output, breaking now-mtime arithmetic or misclassifying hits (see scripts/lib-external-launcher-common.sh:96-106)
suggested_fix: Specify GNU-first then BSD try-fallback: stat -c %Y then stat -f %m, each with 2>/dev/null and [[ value =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; on failure emit MARKER_HIT=false REASON=stat-unavailable return 1; document in lib-design-reentry-guard.md
